name: What are common cost drivers in whole-home renovations?

mainEntity.name: What are common cost drivers in whole-home renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Structural changes, extensive plumbing or electrical relocation, high-end finishes, custom cabinetry, window and door upgrades, and unforeseen conditions behind walls are major factors that affect cost.
